advancements.variants.root.title: Revaried
advancements.variants.root.description: Many variations of existing things! See if you can notice them all.
advancements.variants.obtain_painting_pl: Get some painting planks, which is just the Painting's back texture turned into a wood set.
advancements.variants.obtain_glow_black_: Get some Glow Black Dyes from its tulips.
advancements.variants.find_enderwood_for: Find an Enderwood Forest in the End.
advancements.variants.drink_poisoning_po: Meet your demise by drinking any poisoning pots.
advancements.variants.drink_glowstone_po: Get Glowing from a Glowstone Pot, so everyone can see you've gone insane.
advancements.variants.drink_explosive_bl: Drink an Explosive Blend Pot an go out like a Creeper.
advancements.variants.obtain_painting_do: Craft any non-compat Painting Doors or Trapdoors to hide a room.
advancements.variants.obtain_enderwood_b: Craft an Enderwood Bookshelf. These give 2 enchanting power, so you'll need only around 8.
advancements.variants.obtain_plain_birch: Craft a Plain Birch Bookshelf, a compatibility between Fabricio2010's Pack.
What are You Gonna Grow Here?
Till an Ender Nylium and reflect on what you're going to plant there.
advancements.variants.obtain_elder_prism: Get your hands on some Elder Prismarine, the fanciest and most exotic blocks out there.
Mine for some Raw Debris (it's better to mine it with Fortune now).
advancements.variants.obtain_glow_black_: Make a Glow Black Bed. Villagers can't sleep in it because Minecraft is weird.
advancements.variants.obtain_glow_berry_: Buy a Glow Berry Bush from Wandering Traders (it gives Sweet Berries).
advancements.variants.obtain_sunny_flowe: Find a few Sunny Flowers (you can bonemeal it to grow them).
advancements.variants.obtain_all_shulker: Get all 18 possible Shulker Shell colors.
advancements.variants.obtain_music_disc_: Find the legacy "dog" disc within Creepers.
advancements.variants.obtain_spawner_min: Pickup a Spawner in a Minecart.
advancements.variants.obtain_fish.title: A Lost Species
advancements.variants.obtain_fish.descri: Find and kill Fish in the Ocean (or just fish for it).
advancements.variants.obtain_soul_lava_b: Grab a bucket of Soul Lava (it should've melted your bucket).
Prepare a Fungi Stew from the fungi of the Nether.
advancements.variants.obtain_end_fungi_s: Prepare an End Fungi Stew from End Fungi.
advancements.variants.obtain_milk_bottle: Bottle up some Milk for later.
advancements.variants.obtain_splash_soph: Splash up a Sophie Potion with Gunpowder.
advancements.variants.kill_soul_blaze.de: Kill a Soul Blaze (at least the eyes won't shatter) [NYI].
advancements.variants.craft_rail_with_va: A New Way to Make Rails
Craft a Rail using the new method/recipe.
advancements.variants.obtain_wither_bone: Grab some Wither Bones while you're farming Wither Skeleton Skulls.
advancements.variants.obtain_variants_sp: Craft any Spyglass added by Revaried.
advancements.variants.obtain_emerald_arm: Craft or buy a full set or Emerald armor.
advancements.variants.obtain_debug_bow.d: Buy a Debug Bow from master Fletchers.
advancements.variants.obtain_quick_charg: Get your hands on a Quick Charge V book.
advancements.variants.enter_the_nether.d: Not much has changed here, but there are a few new things.
advancements.variants.enter_the_end.desc: As you can see, nothing significant was changed here... yet.

consume_behavior.variants.add_experience: Gives the player a set amount of experience levels or points depending on its NBT.
consume_behavior.variants.apply_mob_effe: Applies effects from its 'effects' tag. Effects are applied separately from this behavior.
consume_behavior.variants.clear_mob_effe: Clears any effects the entity may have.
Damages the entity eating with a specified damage source and amount.
consume_behavior.variants.eat_item.desc: Eats an item from the behavior's NBT.
consume_behavior.variants.explode.desc: Creates an explosion on the entity eating. It has a configurable radius, set fire and damage source.
consume_behavior.variants.ignite.desc: Ignites the entity eating on fire for a specified amount of ticks.
consume_behavior.variants.multi_behavior: Executes multiple consume behaviors at once. Might break after a certain limit.
consume_behavior.variants.play_sound.des: Plays any sound in the game. Has a configurable volume, pitch, sound category and even if it comes from the player.
consume_behavior.variants.remove_effects: Remove specific effects from the entity if they have it.
consume_behavior.variants.teleport_entit: Teleports an entity either randomly or to a specific position.
